## Activity

During March 2019, North City Eye Clinic completed 494 captures. Activity was delivered through the scheduled clinic sessions, and session lists ran as planned apart from routine leave. The reported activity provides the basis for reviewing image quality and grading outcomes for the month.

## Image quality

Of the 494 captures, 7 were marked ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 1.4%. The result indicates that most captures produced images suitable for assessment. The ungradable cases should continue to be reviewed through routine quality processes so that any recurring issues with image acquisition can be identified and addressed.

## Grading

A total of 87 results were graded referable during March 2019. The median grading wait was 6. This measure provides an overview of the time taken for results to move through grading and should be considered alongside the activity and image-quality findings. Overall, the report records completed activity at North City Eye Clinic, with image quality and grading outcomes documented for the month.
